statement: A root document can retain stable metadata while file versions carry their own bytes, checksums and extracted text.
actakit_implication: Fixture CivicDocument identity separately from Artifact/Representation versions; do not duplicate document identity for every processing version.

statement: Bulk edit/reprocess and file integrity checking coexist without making the bulk action itself the durable domain object.
actakit_implication: Batch/supervised operations may write many individually attributable results without a permanent ReviewBatch entity.

statement: Logical document metadata can remain stable while file versions/checksums/text change through processing.
actakit_implication: Keep CivicDocument identity separate from Artifact and Representation versions.

statement: Unsafe source-path mutation and nondeterministic preprocessing can damage custody or create duplicate processing outcomes.
actakit_implication: Transform only working/derived copies; capture transformation tool/version/config and artifact identity.

statement: Backup/export guidance distinguishes authority-bearing content from regenerable derived material.
actakit_implication: Define backup boundary as DB + originals + non-regenerable state; rebuild FTS/thumbnails/derived caches when safe.
